decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The property would be not suitable for conversion to a House in Multiple Occupation as the original floor space would be less than 130 square metres and would not be located within an area with good access to public transportation and convenient walking distance of town centre facilities. Furthermore, the applicant has failed to demonstrate that the development together with other similar developments in the area would not result in cumulative harm to the character and residential amenity in the area. The proposal is therefore unacceptable in principle, contrary to Local Plan policy SC10, CC1 and CC2. and the Houses in Multiple Occupation SPD.

Reason : 2 - The application has failed to demonstrate that the proposal would not result in increased harm to the residential amenity of neighbouring properties and the character of the area due to increased occupancy and increased comings and goings, contrary to Local Plan policy CC2, SC10 and the Houses in Multiple Occupation SPD.

Reason : 3 - The application has failed to demonstrate that the proposal would have an acceptable impact on the local highway and would not result in additional excessive parking stress on the roads surrounding the development. The proposed development is therefore contrary to Local Plan policy EC2 and the Houses in Multiple Occupation SPD.

Reason : 4 - The proposed development would fail to provide adequate access to cycle parking facilities for the future occupiers, failing to sufficiently promote sustainable modes of transport, and would therefore fail to comply with London Plan policy T5, Local Plan policy EC2 and the Council's Houses in Multiple Occupation SPD.
description: Change of use from the existing single residential house (C3) to house in multiple occupation (Sui Generis) for ten occupants.
